trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions taken:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.0 as the most recent version that was healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back**: checkout-api was rolled back to **v2.3.0** across all three production regions. The rollback was executed and verified successfully.

3. **Opened incident**: Created **INC-0001** (SEV2) titled "checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy," documenting the failure, the rollback mitigation, and the need for root-cause follow-up on the v2.3.1 regression. The on-call engineer has been paged.
